is1.native: Jac emits three full-anchor loads and one location traversal, alongside three transaction commands. The original/final sequence is identical.
is1.webridge: Compare the actual generated CALL against the full and pruned direct sequences; the nested operation map records retained table operations.
is1.set: Conventional SQL combines the Person/location projection with a LEFT JOIN in one business query. Full object hydration remains separate in Jac.

is2.native: Jac already uses explicit jtopk and jroot_many builtins: lateral topK and promoted reply roots. Fifteen full-anchor loads, author projection/traversal and guest resolution remain.
is2.webridge: The Java port preserves the ordinary native sequence. Its MySQL topK adaptation uses finite per-origin branches because MySQL 5.7 lacks LATERAL.
is2.set: One conventional query joins the message mirror, reply-root message and both authors, orders by date/ID, and limits to ten. All twenty historical outputs pass.

is3.native: Jac already projects friend fields in two directional Knows queries. Root/Person loads, type discovery, root permissions and guest resolution remain separate.
is3.webridge: Actual full capture required column aliases and scalar JSON/type metadata compatibility fixes. Each attempt and the selected source snapshot are retained.
is3.set: Conventional SQL combines both incident-edge directions and Person projection in one UNION ALL query. It returns the same twenty historical results.

ic1.native: Jac performs three adjacency-frontier expansions, endpoint filtering and a Person projection. Three anchor loads and two guest lookups remain separate. The final sequence matches the original.
ic1.webridge: This case measures synthesis over an actual frontier-based graph traversal. Capture and synthesis outcomes are recorded at their executed stages.
ic1.set: The measured conventional reference retains frontier BFS. A finite-depth UNION alternative passed twenty outputs but had a higher diagnostic median, so BFS was selected.

ic2.native: Jac already requests topK explicitly. Twenty-five full-anchor loads, two Knows traversals, a HasCreator traversal and a type probe remain separate.
ic2.webridge: Full Java retains the observed object-loading sequence; the declared pruned form removes Jac-specific loading while preserving the query output.
ic2.set: Conventional SQL first selects friends, then unions bounded per-author/type top-20 candidates and applies global top-20. Both candidate and selected outputs were measured against all twenty historical hashes.

ic13.native: Actual execution uses indexed adjacency-frontier BFS. Three frontiers reach the selected endpoint; a periodic schema guard can add one cycle.
ic13.webridge: Full/pruned generated BFS procedures contain about 4.85 million row-index checks at the captured cursor sizes. Their actual quiet latencies and observed table operations are reported separately.
ic13.set: The conventional alternative uses ordered CASE/EXISTS for lengths zero through six, matching the benchmark cap. All twenty outputs pass; its diagnostic median was lower than the BFS candidate.
